content.short: TonStat is a dedicated statistics platform tracking the growth, health, and key metrics of the TON ecosystem.
content.description: TonStat is a comprehensive analytics platform dedicated to providing transparent and up-to-date statistics for the TON blockchain. It tracks a wide range of critical metrics, including the number of active addresses, daily transaction volume, total value locked (TVL) in DeFi protocols, and network growth trends over time. By offering clear data visualizations and reliable insights, TonStat serves as an essential resource for investors, developers, and community members to understand the current state and overall health of the TON ecosystem.
content.meta: Monitor the growth of TON with TonStat. Real-time network statistics and analytics on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
